correctness.rationale: From M’=s-kM and P’=kM, derive P=m+st-M. Direct stagewise solution yields integrated M for any order. Its source term is a symmetric constant minus s r_middle z_a z_b z_c; hence the exposure supply term depends only on the middle rate. Cumulative initial-stock hazards yield strict elimination to two max/two min candidates; exact signed gaps (a-b) z_a z_b (s z_c-m) and (b-c) z_b z_c (m-s z_a) prove all cases, ties and no other extrema for a>b>c>0 and m,s,h>0. Two-block comparison has no supply dependence even for unequal durations. Reproducibility checker independently tests stage integrations and exact rational boundaries with 22,058 assertions; finite checks are supplemental, not an all-domain proof.

originality.rationale: Compared exact theorem and its two threshold implications against historical 1972 exponential pollutant wash-off, the first publicly dated 2003 experimental event-response literature, full open 2006 analytical stormwater-control treatment, and 2008 author-manuscript first-order washoff model. These treat initial buildup, fixed storm intensity/volume, event loads, or probabilistic management, but none of the inspected material states the six-permutation accumulated-pool exposure extrema under concurrent fresh supply. Separate general sequencing risk remains: this is best-knowledge originality, not independence or a database uniqueness certificate.
residual_risks: Generic linear-control permutation scheduling or adjacent-swap rearrangement may imply the result without sharing its environmental terminology; earlier equivalence remains possible.
The 1996 Barbé–Cruise–Mo manuscript could not be read in full; abstract evidence alone cannot exclude stronger historical coverage.
The simplified common surface stock plus source does not identify with all implemented urban water quality models, including SWMM receiving-water treatment.

value.rationale: Time-integrated accumulation in an unflushed receiving pool is a natural proxy that discriminates early from late pollutant export. A complete six-permutation classification with two exact supply-to-initial-stock thresholds, exact boundary ties, independence from the intermediate rate, and a two-stage impossibility answers a nontrivial event-ordering question omitted from the cited fixed-event buildup/washoff studies. The model is deliberately idealized and carries no empirical exposure prediction or automatic management recommendation.
